screenrec.label.result: What you recorded — check it, then download
screenrec.status.idle: Hit start and your browser asks which screen to capture. The recording is never uploaded anywhere.
screenrec.err.unsupported: This browser cannot record the screen. Try Chrome or Edge.
screenrec.warn.noMic: The microphone is unavailable, so only system sound is captured.
screenrec.say.recording: Recording. Hit stop, or use your browser’s stop-sharing button.
screenrec.err.empty: Nothing was captured. Stopping right after starting does that — try recording for a few seconds.
screenrec.file.name: screen-recording
